shortDescription: Manages virtual machines snapshots in vCenter

options.name: datacenter
options.description: Datacenter to search for the virtual machine.

options.name: description
options.description: Define an arbitrary description to attach to snapshot.

options.name: folder
options.description: Absolute or relative folder path to search for the virtual machine. This parameter is required if O(name) is supplied. For example 'datacenter name/vm/path/to/folder' or 'path/to/folder'

options.name: folder_paths_are_absolute
options.description: If true, any folder path parameters are treated as absolute paths. If false, modules will try to intelligently determine if the path is absolute or relative. This option is useful when your environment has a complex folder structure. By default, modules will try to intelligently determine if the path is absolute or relative. They may mistakenly prepend the datacenter name or other folder names, and this option can be used to avoid this.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: memory_dump
options.description: If set to V(true), memory dump of virtual machine is also included in snapshot. Note that memory snapshots take time and resources, this will take longer time to create. If virtual machine does not provide capability to take memory snapshot, then this flag is set to V(false).

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the virtual machine to manage. This is required if O(name) or O(uuid) is not supplied.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to work with. This is required parameter, if O(uuid) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: name_match
options.description: If multiple VMs with the same name exist, use the first or last found.

options.name: new_snapshot_name
options.description: If the snapshot already exists, it will be renamed to this value.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: quiesce
options.description: If set to V(true) and virtual machine is powered on, it will quiesce the file system in virtual machine. Note that VMware Tools are required for this flag. If virtual machine is powered off or VMware Tools are not available, then this flag is set to V(false). If virtual machine does not provide capability to take quiesce snapshot, then this flag is set to V(false).

options.name: remove_all
options.description: Removes all snapshots in VM if set to true. Allowed only when O(state) is C(absent)

options.name: remove_children
options.description: If set to V(true) and O(state=absent), then the entire snapshot subtree will be removed.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: The ID of the snapshot to manage. This option cannot be used when creating a new snapshot. Either this parameter or O(snapshot_name) is required if O(remove_all) is set to False.

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: The name of the snapshot to manage. Either this parameter or O(snapshot_id) is required if O(remove_all) is set to False.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage snapshot(s) attached to a specific virtual machine. If set to V(present) and the snapshot absent, a new snapshot will be created with the given name. If set to V(present), the snapshot is present, and O(new_snapshot_name) or O(description) are set, the snapshot name or description is updated. If set to V(absent) and snapshot present, then the snapshot with the given name is removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout value in seconds for the module to wait for the task to finish.

options.name: use_instance_uuid
options.description: Whether to use the VMware instance UUID rather than the BIOS UUID.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the instance to manage. This is VMware's BIOS UUID by default. This is required if O(name) or O(moid) parameter is not supplied.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
